title: eliciting-banking-brief input contract
description: ENFORCED — the engine validates this ASSEMBLED stage input against this schema BEFORE the stage runs (engine/validation.py validate_stage_input; fail-closed, engine/config/runtime-binding.yaml input_validation: enforce). Shape below is the POST-adapter payload delivered at stage ba-research.

raw_request.description: The raw BA input (Jira, Slack, meeting notes, email, mixed prose). Very short input is NOT rejected here — it yields output_type: needs_clarification (EC-05).

requester.description: Named human who submitted the request (provenance).

normalized_request.description: Pick from `intake`: the PII-redacted normalized request STRING (the boundary, the producer schema and the corpus all emit a string; the structured breakdown stays in intake's scope_sheet, which is NOT passed downstream).

discovery.description: engine-nested (NESTED_HANDOFF): the s1-discovery picks, delivered as one advisory object. Absent when discovery did not run — behaviour is then byte-identical.

problem_framing.description: Shape: researching-ba-problem-space schemas/output.json#/properties/problem_framing — a STRING (the producer, its boundary and the corpus all agree).

regulatory_regimes.description: Array of STRINGS. Guaranteed by the producer (s1-discovery required_fields since the 2026-07-12 reshape); may be [] = none identified. Seeds pending-citation rows / a tier FLOOR only — never suppresses a detector.

recommendation.description: proceed | needs-work | do-not-build; only proceed releases this node.

audit_id.description: Provenance ref recorded as frontmatter.upstream_refs.discovery_audit_id — distinct from this skill's own audit_id.

handoff_to_intake.description: Optional typed handoff (tier_signal, stakeholder_hints) — read via discovery.handoff_to_intake.*; producer does not guarantee it.

idempotency_key.description: engine-injected: the workflow's single idempotency key, injected into every stage payload.

upstream_artifacts.description: engine-injected: map of producer stage id to its artifact path relative to this stage's dir.

loop_back_feedback.description: engine-injected (conditional): reviewer findings threaded into a re-run after a loop_back.
